column1: # VoiMate-curated rare single chars. Format: surface<TAB>pinyin_plain.
# 𰻝 (U+30EDD, CJK Ext G) is the simplified encoded biang glyph: the
# official OpenCC t2s normalizes the other encoded glyph 𰻞 (U+30EDE)
# onto it, and the active PingFang on macOS/iOS renders it. SIP variants
# 𱿗 (U+31FD7) and 𲁓 (U+32053) stay out: no system glyph, they would
# render through LastResort. cedict placeholder rows (U+25A1) are
# rejected at ingest and never shipped.
